purpose: Define explicit acceptance criteria for dense embeddings as COMPLEMENTARY views (not primary navigation)

context.dense_role: COMPLEMENTARY (citation heritage view, cross-lingual view, linear hybrid complement)

citation_heritage_view.metric: AUC for recovering cited precedent pairs
citation_heritage_view.target: citation_based dense embeddings must exceed 0.75 AUC on frozen 137k pair pool

sachverhalt.rationale: Sachverhalt (facts) showed best cross-lingual alignment in section experiments (gap 0.187 vs 0.452)
sachverhalt.validation: Section-segmented dense embeddings with bge/bger mapping

dispositiv.validation: Section-segmented dense embeddings with bge/bger mapping

erwaegungen.rationale: Erwaegungen (reasoning) weakest cross-lingual alignment but still useful for doctrine view
erwaegungen.validation: Section-segmented dense embeddings with bge/bger mapping

linear_hybrid_complement.rationale: Linear hybrids at optimal weight PASS adversarial gates but remain BELOW TF-IDF baseline (JP 0.66-0.67 vs 0.78-0.79)
linear_hybrid_complement.validation: Formal suite adversarial gates on 2000 decision stratified sample

true_oos_jurist_preference_ceiling.implication: Dense embeddings cannot be primary navigation mode

v18_coarse_hierarchy.implication: Coarse legal taxonomy recovery fails for dense embeddings

citation_heritage_recall_at_10.implication: Citation heritage is ranking signal, not retrieval signal

boilerplate_resistance_dense.implication: Dense embeddings more susceptible to procedural boilerplate

bge_bger_id_mapping.impact: Cannot align 174k dense embeddings with evaluation metadata (bger_ IDs)

parquet_2022_2026.impact: 29,520 decisions (2022-2026) missing from parquet, cannot compute 174k dense embeddings

section_extraction_174k.impact: Cross-lingual section alignment needs sachverhalt/erwaegungen/dispositiv at 174k scale

validation_protocol.citation_heritage: Run validate_citation_heritage_174k.py on frozen 137k pair pool with 174k dense embeddings
validation_protocol.cross_lingual: Compute section-segmented embeddings (sachverhalt/dispositiv/erwaegungen), evaluate cross_lang_same_branch per section
validation_protocol.linear_hybrid: Run formal suite adversarial gates on hybrid weights 0.3, 0.35, 0.4 with 174k dense + TF-IDF
validation_protocol.scale: All criteria must hold at full 174k (not subsampled)
